definitions.explanation: An interrogative word used to ask about a number or position in a sequence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：00527_denwa⟧{番号|ばんごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何番|なんばん}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: Which bus number are you taking?

notes:
{何番|なんばん} asks "what number" or "which number."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {何番|なんばん}ですか (What number is it?)
- {何番|なんばん}{線|せん} (which platform/line)
- {何番|なんばん}{目|め} (which one in order)

Related: {番号|ばんごう} (number), {番地|ばんち} (address number)
